Research themes
Intelligent sensing and internet of things
H2
Our research merges sensor technology, connectivity and data analytics to create smart, interconnected systems. We design networks of sensors and Internet of Things (IoT) devices that monitor infrastructure and the environment in real time, converting raw data into actionable intelligence.
Infrastructure and smart cities
H2
Resiliet infrastructure and smart cities focuses on creating sustainable, resilient urban environments through innovation in infrastructure design and technology. This theme addresses how we build and manage cities to withstand climate impacts while improving liveability.
Water environment and climate adaptation
H2
Our research safeguards ecosystems and prepares communities for climate change. It includes developing advanced water treatment and recycling technologies to ensure sustainable water supplies, as well as innovative methods for monitoring environmental health and remediating pollution.
Materials and nanotechnology
H2
Materials and nanotechnology explores the design and engineering of novel materials – from the nanoscale building blocks to bulk composites – to unlock new capabilities for technology and infrastructure. Our researchers push the frontiers of material science, creating substances with tailored structures and extraordinary properties
Research centres and institutions
Centre for Advanced Structural Engineering
H2
We are promoting the advancement of structural engineering within Australia through research and development, cooperation with industry and education in contemporary structural technology.
Centre for Wind, Waves and Water
H2
We promote and support collaborative academic and industry-sponsored research in energy harvesting and energy efficiency, water quality and water resources management, wind engineering, and environmental modelling.
Sydney Centre in Geomechanics and Mining Materials
H2
We are at the forefront of research in geomechanics and granular physics, and aim to broaden our world-leading position in fields such as mining geomechanics and bulk material handling.
